CLASS LRUCache:
    // Use a combination of a dictionary and a doubly linked list (or an ordered map)
    cache <- EMPTY DICTIONARY
    capacity <- given capacity
order <- EMPTY LIST
    // (or a doubly linked list to maintain access order)

    FUNCTION get(key):
        IF key NOT IN cache:
            RETURN -1
            // or NULL
        // Move key to front of order (most recently used)
        order.remove(key)
        order.insert_front(key)
        RETURN cache[key]

    FUNCTION put(key, value):
        IF key IN cache:
            // Update value and move key to front
            cache[key] <- value
            order.remove(key)
            order.insert_front(key)
        ELSE:
            IF LENGTH OF order >= capacity:
                // Evict the least recently used (last element in order)
                lruKey <- order[LAST]
                order.remove_back()
                cache.remove(lruKey)
            order.insert_front(key)
            cache[key] <- value

CLASS LRUCache ACCEPTS(capacity)
    given_capacity <- capacity
    cache <- EMPTY DICTIONARY
    order <- EMPTY LIST

    FUNCTION get ACCEPTS(key)
        IF key NOT IN cache:
            RETURN -1
            // or NULL
        // Move key to front of order (most recently used)
        CALL remove_from_list(order, key)
        CALL insert_front(order, key)
        RETURN cache[key]
    ENDFUNCTION

    FUNCTION put ACCEPTS(key, value)
        IF key IN cache:
            // Update value and move key to front
            cache[key] <- value
            CALL remove_from_list(order, key)
            CALL insert_front(order, key)
        ELSE:
            IF LENGTH OF order >= given_capacity:
                // Evict the least recently used (last element in order)
                lruKey <- order[-1]
                CALL remove_last_from_list(order)
                CALL remove_key(cache, lruKey)
            CALL insert_front(order, key)
            cache[key] <- value
    ENDFUNCTION
